text:
A balanced season at the desk began with your short note, and we are troubled that your experience with Aurelia Skyways did not reflect the care we promise for companion animals. You said the handoff felt rushed, the guidance was unclear, and you were left worried about Maple's comfort and safety during the journey. We take that seriously, because every animal in our care deserves calm handling, steady attention, and respectful communication from start to finish.

Our routine review shows that the team should have explained each step more clearly and checked in with you sooner. We are reinforcing that handlers use calm, humane methods at all times, and that they speak plainly so travelers know what is happening with their pet. We also remind staff that a shared journey means shared responsibility, which includes careful listening, patient updates, and a steady focus on animal welfare.

We are sorry for the strain this placed on your trip. Please be assured that the Companion Animal Travel Desk is reviewing the interaction and sharing the concern with the service team so that the next contact is more careful and more reassuring. If you choose to travel with us again, we want the process to feel orderly, gentle, and fully transparent from the first check-in to the final handoff. Your feedback helps us improve the standard we expect of ourselves, and we appreciate you bringing it to our attention.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
